name: The Abduction of the Sabine Women
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “The Abduction of the Sabine Women” by Luca Giordano (c. 1675), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 111620. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
